RK_ENCHANTBLADE: Coats the caster's blade in magic so that each melee blow also deals magic damage.
RK_SONICWAVE: Launches a wave of force at a distant target. The damage falls off if the caster is far away.
RK_DEATHBOUND: Defensive stance. The next physical blow taken is absorbed and returned to the attacker and everything around it.
RK_HUNDREDSPEAR: Flurry of spear thrusts on a single target, with a chance to follow up with a Spear Boomerang.
RK_WINDCUTTER: Sweeps a gust of wind over the area in front of the caster and may Fear the targets.
RK_IGNITIONBREAK: Slams the ground and sets off a Fire explosion. The closer the target, the heavier the damage.
RK_DRAGONTRAINING: Passive. Reduces the weight of the caster's dragon and improves the damage it helps deal.
RK_DRAGONBREATH: While mounted on a dragon, breathes a torrent of flame over a wide area. The damage scales with the caster's HP and SP.
RK_DRAGONHOWLING: The dragon lets out a howl that may Fear every enemy around the caster.
RK_RUNEMASTERY: Passive. Improves the rune stones the caster can carve and the odds of carving them successfully.
RK_MILLENNIUMSHIELD: Rune. Raises a random number of shields around the caster, each absorbing one incoming hit.
RK_CRUSHSTRIKE: Rune. The caster's next melee blow deals massive damage, but destroys the weapon used.
RK_REFRESH: Rune. Clears most abnormal status effects and restores part of the caster's HP.
RK_GIANTGROWTH: Rune. Sharply raises STR and gives melee blows a chance to strike for triple damage, at the risk of breaking the weapon.
RK_STONEHARDSKIN: Rune. Spends HP to harden the skin, reducing physical damage taken but risking the caster's armor.
RK_VITALITYACTIVATION: Rune. Doubles the effect of HP recovery items and natural regeneration, but halves healing magic.
RK_STORMBLAST: Rune. Strike that consumes rune stones to deal damage based on the caster's STR and rune mastery.
RK_FIGHTINGSPIRIT: Rune. Raises the ATK of the caster and of every Rune Knight in the party, based on how many are banded together.
RK_ABUNDANCE: Rune. Sharply increases the caster's SP recovery for a long while.
RK_PHANTOMTHRUST: Spear thrust that reaches a distant enemy and drags it to the caster.
GC_VENOMIMPRESS: Marks the target so that it takes far more Poison property damage.
GC_CROSSIMPACT: Blindingly fast series of blows delivered after closing on the target.
GC_DARKILLUSION: Teleports the caster onto the target and strikes it, with a chance of a critical hit.
GC_RESEARCHNEWPOISON: Passive. Extends the duration of the new poisons and improves the odds of brewing them.
GC_CREATENEWPOISON: Brews one of the new poisons from the required ingredients.
GC_ANTIDOTE: Cures the target of the new poisons.
GC_POISONINGWEAPON: Coats the caster's weapon with a new poison, letting its blows inflict that poison.
GC_WEAPONBLOCKING: Stance that gives a chance to parry incoming weapon attacks, opening the way to Counter Slash.
GC_COUNTERSLASH: Riposte usable right after Weapon Blocking parries a blow. Damage rises with the caster's AGI.
GC_WEAPONCRUSH: Follow-up to Weapon Blocking that strips the target of its weapon.
GC_VENOMPRESSURE: Hurls a poison bottle that always hits and applies the caster's poison to the target.
GC_POISONSMOKE: Lays a cloud of poison smoke on the ground that poisons anyone standing in it. Requires an active poison.
GC_CLOAKINGEXCEED: Advanced cloaking that keeps the caster fast and hidden even away from walls, but breaks after enough hits.
GC_PHANTOMMENACE: Reveals every hidden enemy around the caster and strikes them.
GC_HALLUCINATIONWALK: For a short while the caster becomes extremely hard to hit, at the cost of a large amount of HP.
GC_ROLLINGCUTTER: Spinning slash that hits everything around the caster and builds up Rotation stacks.
GC_CROSSRIPPERSLASHER: Hurls the blades outward, spending the Rotation stacks built by Rolling Cutter to raise the damage.
AB_JUDEX: Holy judgement that strikes the target and the enemies next to it.
AB_ANCILLA: Creates Ancilla, the catalyst consumed by several Arch Bishop skills.
AB_ADORAMUS: Calls down a pillar of light that damages the target and may Blind it. Consumes Ancilla or Blue Gemstones.
AB_CLEMENTIA: Casts Blessing on every party member around the caster.
AB_CANTO: Casts Increase AGI on every party member around the caster.
AB_CHEAL: Heals every party member around the caster at once.
AB_EPICLESIS: Consecrates the ground: allies inside recover HP and SP over time and dead Novices can be revived.
AB_PRAEFATIO: Party version of Kyrie Eleison. Shields every member with a barrier that absorbs incoming hits.
AB_ORATIO: Prayer that lowers the Holy property resistance of every enemy around the caster.
AB_LAUDAAGNUS: Prayer that cures Freeze, Stone Curse, Blind and Stun on the party and raises their VIT.
AB_LAUDARAMUS: Prayer that cures Sleep, Silence, Confusion and Hallucination on the party and raises their LUK.
AB_EUCHARISTICA: Passive. Raises the caster's Holy property damage and Shadow property resistance.
AB_RENOVATIO: Blessing that regenerates the target's HP over time. Damages Undead property targets instead.
AB_HIGHNESSHEAL: Greatly amplified Heal. Cannot be used on Undead property targets.
AB_CLEARANCE: Strips every buff from the target. Also removes debuffs from allies.
AB_EXPIATIO: Blesses the target's weapon so that its attacks pierce part of the enemy's DEF.
AB_DUPLELIGHT: Passive. Gives each normal attack a chance to trigger an extra holy melee or magic strike.
AB_DUPLELIGHT_MELEE: Melee strike triggered by Duple Light. Not castable on its own.
AB_DUPLELIGHT_MAGIC: Magic strike triggered by Duple Light. Not castable on its own.
AB_SILENTIUM: Silences every enemy around the caster.
AB_SECRAMENT: Blesses the target so that its cast time is reduced for a long while.
WL_WHITEIMPRISON: Traps the target in a block of ice: it can neither act nor be harmed, except by Shadow and Ghost magic. May backfire on the caster.
WL_SOULEXPANSION: Ghost property blast that hits the target and the enemies next to it. Deals double damage to a target held by White Imprison.
WL_FROSTMISTY: Wraps every enemy around the caster in freezing mist, slowing them and setting up Jack Frost.
WL_JACKFROST: Shards of ice erupt from the ground around the caster. Targets already caught in Frosty Misty take far more damage.
WL_MARSHOFABYSS: Sinks the target into a marsh, sharply lowering its movement speed, AGI and DEX.
WL_RECOGNIZEDSPELL: Focus stance: every offensive spell deals its maximum MATK, but SP consumption rises sharply.
WL_SIENNAEXECRATE: Curse that may turn the target and the enemies next to it to stone.
WL_RADIUS: Passive. Widens the caster's spell range and shortens the fixed cast time of Warlock spells.
WL_STASIS: Seals the area so that no one inside can cast most spells.
WL_DRAINLIFE: Siphons the target's life and turns part of the damage dealt into HP for the caster.
WL_CRIMSONROCK: Slams a huge burning rock down on the area, knocking the victims back.
WL_HELLINFERNO: Shadow flames that burn the target over time. Deals far more damage to a target held by White Imprison.
WL_COMET: Pulls a comet down on the chosen spot. Enormous damage over a wide area, at a heavy SP and gemstone cost.
WL_CHAINLIGHTNING: Bolt of lightning that leaps from the target to nearby enemies, weakening at every jump.
WL_EARTHSTRAIN: Tears the ground open in a wide line, damaging enemies and stripping their equipment.
WL_TETRAVORTEX: Merges four elemental spheres into a vortex that strikes the target with all four properties in turn.
WL_SUMMONFB: Summons a Fire sphere that orbits the caster and powers the elemental spells.
WL_SUMMONBL: Summons a Lightning sphere that orbits the caster and powers the elemental spells.
WL_SUMMONWB: Summons a Water sphere that orbits the caster and powers the elemental spells.
WL_SUMMONSTONE: Summons an Earth sphere that orbits the caster and powers the elemental spells.
WL_RELEASE: Fires the summoned spheres at the target, or unleashes a spell memorised in the spellbook.
WL_READING_SB: Memorises a spell from a spellbook so that it can later be unleashed with Release.
WL_FREEZE_SP: Passive. Increases the number of spells the caster can hold memorised at once.
RA_ARROWSTORM: Rains arrows down over a wide area around the target.
RA_FEARBREEZE: Stance that gives the caster's bow a chance to loose several arrows at once.
RA_RANGERMAIN: Passive. Raises damage against Brute, Plant and Fish enemies, and improves SP recovery.
RA_AIMEDBOLT: Pins the target with a bolt and follows up with repeated hits. Deals far more damage to a trapped enemy.
RA_DETONATOR: Sets off the caster's traps on the field from a distance.
RA_ELECTRICSHOCKER: Trap that binds whoever steps on it and drains its SP.
RA_CLUSTERBOMB: Trap that bursts into a cluster of explosions over the surrounding area.
RA_WUGMASTERY: Lets the caster tame and call a Warg. Also used to release it.
RA_WUGRIDER: Lets the caster mount the Warg and ride it.
RA_WUGDASH: Charges forward on the Warg, running down anything in the way.
RA_WUGSTRIKE: Orders the Warg to lunge at the target and bite it.
RA_WUGBITE: The Warg clamps its jaws on the target, holding it in place.
RA_TOOTHOFWUG: Passive. Raises the damage the Warg deals with its bite.
RA_SENSITIVEKEEN: Sharpens the caster's senses to reveal hidden enemies around it, and may order the Warg to strike.
RA_CAMOUFLAGE: Blends the caster into the surroundings. Damage and CRIT rise the longer it lasts, but it breaks in the open.
RA_RESEARCHTRAP: Passive. Improves the caster's traps and allows some of them to be recovered.
RA_MAGENTATRAP: Trap that changes the property of whoever steps on it to Fire.
RA_COBALTTRAP: Trap that changes the property of whoever steps on it to Water.
RA_MAIZETRAP: Trap that changes the property of whoever steps on it to Earth.
RA_VERDURETRAP: Trap that changes the property of whoever steps on it to Wind.
RA_FIRINGTRAP: Trap that bursts into flame, burning whoever steps on it.
RA_ICEBOUNDTRAP: Trap that bursts into frost, chilling whoever steps on it.
NC_MADOLICENCE: Passive. Grants the right to pilot a Magic Gear and improves its movement speed.
NC_BOOSTKNUCKLE: Fires the Magic Gear's fist at the target. Damage scales with the caster's DEX.
NC_PILEBUNKER: Drives a piston into the target at point blank range, stripping most of its buffs.
NC_VULCANARM: Rapid fire volley. Damage scales with the caster's DEX.
NC_FLAMELAUNCHER: Sprays burning fuel over the target, setting it ablaze.
NC_COLDSLOWER: Sprays freezing gas over the area, chilling and slowing the enemies inside.
NC_ARMSCANNON: Fires a heavy shell that damages the target and everything around it.
NC_ACCELERATION: Overdrives the Magic Gear's engine, sharply raising its movement speed.
NC_HOVERING: Lifts the Magic Gear off the ground, ignoring ground traps and terrain effects.
NC_F_SIDESLIDE: Thruster burst that shoves the Magic Gear forward a few cells.
NC_B_SIDESLIDE: Thruster burst that shoves the Magic Gear backward a few cells.
NC_MAINFRAME: Passive. Restructures the Magic Gear's frame, raising the limit at which it overheats.
NC_SELFDESTRUCTION: Blows up the Magic Gear, damaging everything around it based on the caster's remaining HP and SP.
NC_SHAPESHIFT: Swaps the Magic Gear's elemental property using the matching magic stone.
NC_EMERGENCYCOOL: Vents the Magic Gear's heat, lowering its overheat gauge.
NC_INFRAREDSCAN: Sweeps the area with infrared, revealing hidden enemies and lowering their FLEE.
NC_ANALYZE: Scans the target, sharply reducing its DEF and MDEF for a while.
NC_MAGNETICFIELD: Pins every enemy around the Magic Gear in place and drains their SP.
NC_NEUTRALBARRIER: Raises a barrier that blocks ranged physical and magical attacks from outside.
NC_STEALTHFIELD: Hides the caster and the allies inside the field, at a steady SP cost.
NC_REPAIR: Repairs a damaged Magic Gear, restoring part of its HP.
NC_TRAININGAXE: Passive. Raises damage dealt with Axe and Mace class weapons.
NC_RESEARCHFE: Passive. Improves the caster's Fire and Earth research, raising damage with the matching skills.
NC_AXEBOOMERANG: Hurls the axe at the target. Damage rises with the weapon's weight.
NC_POWERSWING: Heavy swing that may Stun the target and can chain into Axe Boomerang.
NC_AXETORNADO: Whirls the axe around the caster, damaging every enemy nearby with a Wind property strike.
NC_SILVERSNIPER: Deploys a Silver Sniper turret that fires at nearby enemies on its own.
NC_MAGICDECOY: Deploys a Magic Decoy that casts elemental bolts at nearby enemies on its own.
NC_DISJOINT: Dismantles one of the caster's deployed turrets, or destroys an enemy one.
SC_FATALMENACE: Strikes every enemy around the caster and warps the whole party to the chosen spot.
SC_REPRODUCE: Learns and stores one skill used on the caster, so that it can be cast at a higher SP cost.
SC_AUTOSHADOWSPELL: Stance that gives a chance to auto-cast a memorised or Plagiarised spell when attacking.
SC_SHADOWFORM: Binds the caster to a target: part of the damage the caster takes is transferred to it instead.
SC_TRIANGLESHOT: Fires three arrows in a triangle pattern, knocking the target back.
SC_BODYPAINT: Throws paint over the area, revealing hidden enemies and possibly Blinding them.
SC_INVISIBILITY: Turns the caster fully invisible and raises its ATK, at a heavy and constant SP drain.
SC_DEADLYINFECT: Spreads the caster's abnormal status effects to nearby enemies each time it is hit.
SC_ENERVATION: Masquerade that strips the target of its ATK and its spirit spheres.
SC_GROOMY: Masquerade that lowers the target's HIT and unmounts it from its steed.
SC_IGNORANCE: Masquerade that seals the target's SP and prevents it from using skills.
SC_LAZINESS: Masquerade that lowers the target's FLEE and movement speed and raises its cast time.
SC_UNLUCKY: Masquerade that lowers the target's CRIT and perfect dodge, and inflicts Curse or Blind.
SC_WEAKNESS: Masquerade that lowers the target's maximum HP and strips its weapon and shield.
SC_STRIPACCESSARY: Strips the target of its accessories and lowers its DEX, INT and LUK.
SC_MANHOLE: Opens a pit that drops whoever steps on it, leaving it unable to move or act.
SC_DIMENSIONDOOR: Opens a dimensional gate that warps away whoever steps on it.
SC_CHAOSPANIC: Field of confusion that scrambles the movement of everyone caught inside.
SC_MAELSTROM: Whirlpool that swallows any ground skill cast on it and returns SP to the caster.
SC_BLOODYLUST: Drives everyone inside the area into a berserk frenzy they cannot control.
SC_FEINTBOMB: Leaves a decoy behind and blinks the caster away from danger.
LG_CANNONSPEAR: Thrusts the spear forward, running through every enemy in a straight line.
LG_BANISHINGPOINT: Spear strike whose damage rises with the caster's Bash level.
LG_TRAMPLE: Stomps the ground, destroying the traps laid around the caster.
LG_SHIELDPRESS: Slams the shield into the target and may Stun it. Damage rises with the shield's weight and refine.
LG_REFLECTDAMAGE: Stance that returns part of the physical damage taken to the attacker and everything around it.
LG_PINPOINTATTACK: Charges the target and strikes a weak point, breaking equipment or causing Bleeding depending on the level.
LG_FORCEOFVANGUARD: Stance that builds Rage stacks when the caster is hit, and raises its maximum HP.
LG_RAGEBURST: Spends every Rage stack at once in a single heavy blow.
LG_SHIELDSPELL: Unleashes the power stored in the shield. The effect depends on the shield's DEF, MDEF and refine.
LG_EXEEDBREAK: Charges the next blow so that it strikes with devastating force, then ends the stance.
LG_OVERBRAND: Sweeping spear assault that throws the victims back and strikes again those slammed into a wall.
LG_PRESTIGE: Raises the caster's DEF and grants a chance to shrug off magic entirely.
LG_BANDING: Bands nearby Royal Guards together, sharing HP recovery and strengthening them with their numbers.
LG_MOONSLASHER: Downward slash that damages the enemies around the caster and forces them to sit.
LG_RAYOFGENESIS: Holy blast over the area whose damage rises with the number of banded Royal Guards.
LG_PIETY: Blesses the party with the Holy property, protecting them from Shadow and Undead damage.
LG_EARTHDRIVE: Slams the shield into the ground, throwing up dust that lowers the enemies' FLEE and ASPD.
LG_HESPERUSLIT: Combined charge of the banded Royal Guards. The more banded members, the heavier the blow.
LG_INSPIRATION: Battle trance that raises every stat and ATK sharply, at the cost of experience and a steady HP drain.
SR_DRAGONCOMBO: Two quick kicks that may Stun the target and open the way to Fallen Empire.
SR_SKYNETBLOW: Palm strike that blasts every enemy in front of the caster.
SR_EARTHSHAKER: Slams the ground, revealing hidden enemies around the caster and striking them.
SR_FALLENEMPIRE: Grapples the target and slams it down. Damage rises with the target's size and weight.
SR_TIGERCANNON: Spends HP and SP to unleash a devastating blow whose damage scales with the amount consumed.
SR_RAMPAGEBLASTER: Detonates the caster's spirit spheres in a blast that hits every enemy around it.
SR_CRESCENTELBOW: Counter stance: an incoming melee blow is answered with a strike that reflects part of the damage.
SR_CURSEDCIRCLE: Traps every enemy around the caster in a circle where none of them can move or act, the caster included.
SR_LIGHTNINGWALK: Stance that lets the caster blink to the source of an incoming ranged or magical attack.
SR_KNUCKLEARROW: Hurls the target away with a knuckle strike, hitting it again if it slams into a wall.
SR_WINDMILL: Spinning sweep that knocks down every enemy around the caster.
SR_RAISINGDRAGON: Raises the caster's maximum HP and SP and lets it hold more spirit spheres, at a steady HP cost.
SR_ASSIMILATEPOWER: Absorbs the spirit spheres of the target and turns them into SP for the caster.
SR_POWERVELOCITY: Hands the caster's spirit spheres over to an ally.
SR_GATEOFHELL: Spends nearly all of the caster's HP and SP in a single overwhelming strike.
SR_GENTLETOUCH_QUIET: Pressure point strike that silences the target and lowers its HIT or FLEE.
SR_GENTLETOUCH_CURE: Pressure point touch that heals an ally and cures several abnormal statuses.
SR_GENTLETOUCH_ENERGYGAIN: Stance that gives the caster a chance to gain a spirit sphere whenever it attacks or is hit.
SR_GENTLETOUCH_CHANGE: Stance that trades the caster's DEF and MDEF for a large boost to ATK and ASPD.
SR_GENTLETOUCH_REVITALIZE: Stance that raises the caster's VIT, DEF, movement speed and HP recovery.
SR_HOWLINGOFLION: A roar that strikes every enemy around the caster and may Fear them, cancelling performances.
SR_RIDEINLIGHTNING: Wind property burst that damages every enemy in the target area.
WA_SWING_DANCE: Performance that raises the movement speed and ASPD of the whole party.
WA_SYMPHONY_OF_LOVER: Performance that raises the MDEF of the whole party.
WA_MOONLIT_SERENADE: Performance that raises the MATK of the whole party.
MI_RUSH_WINDMILL: Performance that raises the ATK of the whole party.
MI_ECHOSONG: Performance that raises the DEF of the whole party.
MI_HARMONIZE: Performance that evens out the target's stats, raising the lowest at the expense of the highest.
WM_LESSON: Passive. Raises the caster's maximum SP and the power of every performance.
WM_METALICSOUND: Piercing note that damages the target and drains its SP. Far more effective against a sleeping target.
WM_REVERBERATION: Places a resonating sphere on the ground that bursts on contact, dealing both physical and magical damage.
WM_DOMINION_IMPULSE: Sets off every Reverberation sphere on the field from a distance.
WM_SEVERE_RAINSTORM: Rains arrows down over the target area, hitting repeatedly.
WM_POEMOFNETHERWORLD: Song that roots everyone standing on the enchanted ground in place.
WM_VOICEOFSIREN: Song that charms nearby enemies so that they cannot attack the caster.
WM_DEADHILLHERE: Revives a fallen ally on the spot by spending the caster's SP.
WM_LULLABY_DEEPSLEEP: Lullaby that puts everyone around the caster into Deep Sleep.
WM_SIRCLEOFNATURE: Song that restores the HP of the party members inside, at a steady SP cost.
WM_RANDOMIZESPELL: Improvised song that casts a random offensive spell at the target.
WM_GLOOMYDAY: Song that leaves the target dispirited, lowering its FLEE and ASPD but empowering a few of its skills.
WM_GREAT_ECHO: Combined performance with another performer, striking the target area with a wave of sound.
WM_SONG_OF_MANA: Song that restores the SP of the party members inside.
WM_DANCE_WITH_WUG: Performance that raises the ASPD of the whole party, scaling with the number of nearby performers.
WM_SOUND_OF_DESTRUCTION: Wave of sound that cancels the performances in progress in the area.
WM_SATURDAY_NIGHT_FEVER: Frenzied dance that forces everyone inside to fight on with no defence and no control.
WM_LERADS_DEW: Song that raises the maximum HP of the party members inside.
WM_MELODYOFSINK: Song that raises the party's MATK while lowering the INT of the enemies inside.
WM_BEYOND_OF_WARCRY: War cry that raises the party's ATK while lowering the STR of the enemies inside.
WM_UNLIMITED_HUMMING_VOICE: Song that prevents everyone inside from having their casting interrupted, at a higher SP cost.
SO_FIREWALK: Leaves a trail of fire behind the caster as it walks, burning the enemies who touch it.
SO_ELECTRICWALK: Leaves a trail of lightning behind the caster as it walks, shocking the enemies who touch it.
SO_SPELLFIST: Stores a bolt spell in the caster's fist so that the next melee blows release it.
SO_EARTHGRAVE: Spikes of earth erupt from the ground over the area, damaging enemies over time.
SO_DIAMONDDUST: Freezing dust settles over the area, damaging enemies and possibly crystallizing them.
SO_POISON_BUSTER: Detonates the poison inside an already poisoned target for heavy damage.
SO_PSYCHIC_WAVE: Wave of psychic force that batters the target area repeatedly.
SO_CLOUD_KILL: Cloud of poison that damages and poisons anyone standing in it.
SO_STRIKING: Blesses an ally's weapon, raising its ATK and CRIT for a while.
SO_WARMER: Warm field that regenerates the HP of the allies inside and thaws frozen ones.
SO_VACUUM_EXTREME: Vacuum that pulls in everyone nearby and holds them at its centre.
SO_VARETYR_SPEAR: Spear of lightning that strikes the target and may Stun it. Empowered by a Wind spirit.
SO_ARRULLO: Lullaby that puts every enemy in the area into Deep Sleep.
SO_EL_CONTROL: Sets the behaviour of the summoned elemental spirit: passive, defensive or aggressive.
SO_SUMMON_AGNI: Summons Agni, the Fire spirit, to fight alongside the caster.
SO_SUMMON_AQUA: Summons Aqua, the Water spirit, to fight alongside the caster.
SO_SUMMON_VENTUS: Summons Ventus, the Wind spirit, to fight alongside the caster.
SO_SUMMON_TERA: Summons Tera, the Earth spirit, to fight alongside the caster.
SO_EL_ACTION: Orders the summoned spirit to use its skill on the chosen target at once.
SO_EL_ANALYSIS: Breaks elemental stones down into lower grade ones, or combines them into higher grade ones.
SO_EL_SYMPATHY: Passive. Strengthens the summoned spirit and lowers the SP cost of keeping it.
SO_EL_CURE: Restores the HP and SP of the summoned spirit at the cost of the caster's own.
SO_FIRE_INSIGNIA: Fire insignia that empowers Fire property allies and skills inside its area.
SO_WATER_INSIGNIA: Water insignia that empowers Water property allies and skills inside its area.
SO_WIND_INSIGNIA: Wind insignia that empowers Wind property allies and skills inside its area.
SO_EARTH_INSIGNIA: Earth insignia that empowers Earth property allies and skills inside its area.
GN_TRAINING_SWORD: Passive. Raises the caster's damage and HIT with One-Handed Sword class weapons.
GN_REMODELING_CART: Passive. Increases the carrying capacity and attack power of the caster's cart.
GN_CART_TORNADO: Spins the cart around the caster, striking every enemy nearby. Damage rises with STR and cart weight.
GN_CARTCANNON: Fires a cannonball from the cart. Its property depends on the cannonball loaded.
GN_CARTBOOST: Overhauls the cart so that the caster moves much faster while pushing it.
GN_THORNS_TRAP: Plants a thorn trap that binds whoever steps on it and wounds it over time.
GN_BLOOD_SUCKER: Plants a leech on the target that drains its HP and hands it to the caster.
GN_SPORE_EXPLOSION: Attaches a spore bomb to the target that bursts after a delay, damaging everything around it.
GN_WALLOFTHORN: Raises a wall of thorns that blocks the way and burns when set on fire.
GN_CRAZYWEED: Hurls weeds down over the area, damaging enemies and clearing away ground skills.
GN_DEMONIC_FIRE: Sets the area ablaze with a fire that keeps burning the enemies inside.
GN_FIRE_EXPANSION: Feeds an item into a Demonic Fire, changing what it does depending on the item used.
GN_HELLS_PLANT: Plants a carnivorous flower that bites the enemies coming within reach.
GN_MANDRAGORA: A shriek that drains SP from every enemy around the caster and raises their cast time.
GN_SLINGITEM: Hurls a consumable item at the target, be it a bomb or a healing item for an ally.
GN_CHANGEMATERIAL: Breaks crafting materials down into other ingredients.
GN_MIX_COOKING: Cooks several servings of food at once from the required ingredients.
GN_MAKEBOMB: Crafts throwing bombs from the required ingredients.
GN_S_PHARMACY: Brews the advanced potions of the Genetic from the required ingredients.
EL_CIRCLE_OF_FIRE: Fire spirit skill. Rings its master with flame that burns whoever attacks in melee.
EL_FIRE_CLOAK: Fire spirit skill. Cloaks its master in flame, raising Fire resistance and reflecting part of the damage.
EL_FIRE_MANTLE: Fire spirit skill. Wraps its master in a mantle of flame that burns nearby enemies.
EL_WATER_SCREEN: Water spirit skill. The spirit takes the damage aimed at its master in its place.
EL_WATER_DROP: Water spirit skill. Raises its master's Water resistance and SP recovery.
EL_WATER_BARRIER: Water spirit skill. Raises a barrier that cuts the damage its master takes, at the cost of ATK and speed.
EL_WIND_STEP: Wind spirit skill. Sharply raises its master's movement speed and FLEE.
EL_WIND_CURTAIN: Wind spirit skill. Raises its master's Wind resistance and lowers its cast time.
EL_ZEPHYR: Wind spirit skill. Surrounds its master with wind, raising FLEE and warding off Silence.
EL_SOLID_SKIN: Earth spirit skill. Hardens its master's skin, raising maximum HP and DEF but slowing it down.
EL_STONE_SHIELD: Earth spirit skill. Raises its master's Earth resistance and DEF.
EL_POWER_OF_GAIA: Earth spirit skill. Raises its master's maximum HP and DEF at the cost of movement speed.
EL_PYROTECHNIC: Fire spirit skill. Raises its master's ATK.
EL_HEATER: Fire spirit skill. Raises its master's ATK further than Pyrotechnic.
EL_TROPIC: Fire spirit skill. Raises its master's ATK to the highest level the Fire spirit can grant.
EL_AQUAPLAY: Water spirit skill. Raises its master's MATK.
EL_COOLER: Water spirit skill. Raises its master's MATK further than Aqua Play.
EL_CHILLY_AIR: Water spirit skill. Raises its master's MATK to the highest level the Water spirit can grant.
EL_GUST: Wind spirit skill. Raises its master's ASPD.
EL_BLAST: Wind spirit skill. Raises its master's ASPD further than Gust.
EL_WILD_STORM: Wind spirit skill. Raises its master's ASPD to the highest level the Wind spirit can grant.
EL_PETROLOGY: Earth spirit skill. Raises its master's maximum HP.
EL_CURSED_SOIL: Earth spirit skill. Raises its master's maximum HP further than Petrology.
EL_UPHEAVAL: Earth spirit skill. Raises its master's maximum HP to the highest level the Earth spirit can grant.
EL_FIRE_ARROW: Fire spirit skill. Looses an arrow of flame at the target.
EL_FIRE_BOMB: Fire spirit skill. Hurls a fire bomb that bursts on the target.
EL_FIRE_BOMB_ATK: Blast of the Fire spirit's fire bomb. Not castable on its own.
EL_FIRE_WAVE: Fire spirit skill. Sends a wave of flame rolling over the target.
EL_FIRE_WAVE_ATK: Impact of the Fire spirit's fire wave. Not castable on its own.
EL_ICE_NEEDLE: Water spirit skill. Impales the target on a needle of ice.
EL_WATER_SCREW: Water spirit skill. Drills a screw of water through the target.
EL_WATER_SCREW_ATK: Impact of the Water spirit's water screw. Not castable on its own.
EL_TIDAL_WEAPON: Water spirit skill. Charges its master's weapon with the tide, raising its Water damage.
EL_WIND_SLASH: Wind spirit skill. Cuts the target with a blade of wind.
EL_HURRICANE: Wind spirit skill. Unleashes a raging hurricane on the target.
EL_HURRICANE_ATK: Impact of the Wind spirit's hurricane. Not castable on its own.
EL_TYPOON_MIS: Wind spirit skill. Fires a typhoon missile at the target.
EL_TYPOON_MIS_ATK: Impact of the Wind spirit's typhoon missile. Not castable on its own.
EL_STONE_HAMMER: Earth spirit skill. Slams the target with a hammer of stone.
EL_ROCK_CRUSHER: Earth spirit skill. Launches a boulder at the target.
EL_ROCK_CRUSHER_ATK: Impact of the Earth spirit's boulder. Not castable on its own.
EL_STONE_RAIN: Earth spirit skill. Calls down a rain of stones on the target area.
